objects.description: The carotid artery represented by the flow dataset.
objects.name: carotid_artery

case_context.physical_setting: Blood flow in human carotid arteries

scientific_question: Investigate high-speed flow regions in the carotid artery flow field: choose an appropriate rule for determining which locations qualify as high-speed and a corresponding measure of regional strength, then select the strongest region. Combine locations connected through immediate grid neighbors along one grid axis into a single contiguous region, summarize it by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations, and report its location and strength.
